admission.ownerOverride: The repository owner explicitly requests a categorical style ban on validation, precondition, postcondition and check blocks, and excludes ordinary branching from the request.
admission.meaning: Matches establish violations of that design policy, not intrinsic Terraform defects or proof that the guarded invariant is redundant.
admission.existingOwners: Terraform owns native syntax, input types, provider validation and lifecycle behavior. Existing SARJ209, SARJ210 and SARJ217 cover narrower redundant validation, terraform_data guards and expression complexity. None implements the requested categorical policy.
admission.noChangeHarm: Infrastructure declarations continue to mix deployment policy with resource configuration, retaining the verbosity and review burden the owner asked to remove.
admission.smallestFix: Recognize Terraform-owned blocks through the shared HCL tree; emit one diagnostic per guard, or one per complete check block. Do not modify infrastructure or automatically delete source.
admission.remediation: Move required invariants into their owning tests or deployment preflight before manual removal. Retain native protection and lifecycle settings.

boundaries: resource, data and ephemeral lifecycle precondition and postcondition
top-level check with nested assertions and data sources
comments, strings, heredocs and labelled lookalikes
other dialects and Terraform JSON abstention
suppression and narrower diagnostic precedence scoped to the actual resource, including malformed and excepted neighbors

corpus.method: Two immutable private Git snapshots, exported as Terraform-only local corpora with pinned content digests. run_isolated_corpora runs the native candidate CLI in independent verified batches. Private provenance retains revisions, source, paths and identifying hashes; none is published here.
corpus.sampleMethod: All four postconditions and the 23 lowest SHA256-ranked locations in each of the validation and precondition clusters: 50 inspected matches. Ranking uses location independently of source text. Each major observed guard kind is represented.
corpus.interpretation: Reviewed matches enforce ranges, formats, identity/security requirements, migration sequencing and service dependencies. These are genuine guard blocks under the requested policy; many protect meaningful invariants that must be preserved elsewhere before removal. Unreviewed matches and unlabeled zeroes do not estimate field precision or recall. No check blocks occurred in this corpus; native synthetic examples cover that owner.

performance.method: Full native IaC registry over the same 389 frozen Terraform files and 2,094,622 bytes, five alternating baseline/candidate fresh-process pairs. Cold is the first analysis after imports and file reads; each process then performs three warm analyses. Baseline is public main source at the recorded revision, not a disabled candidate rule. Same pinned Python 3.15.0 and contracts 0.8.0 environment. macOS process lifetime ru_maxrss is converted from bytes to KiB.
performance.limitations: Shared host and OS caches; no page-cache eviction, statistical significance, universal precision or worst-case overhead claim. Measurements exclude module import and source-read time from analysis timings, but wall time includes process startup. Existing diagnostics are compared exactly in a separate native pass.

verificationCommands: uv run --project packages/standards --frozen code-standards --root . maintain rules prepare iac:no-terraform-guard-blocks
uv run --frozen ruff check src tests (packages/iac)
limitations: This is an explicitly requested team style policy, not a runtime-correctness detector.
Terraform JSON, Terraform test assertions and other HCL dialects are outside the rule.
The shared HCL parser recovers some malformed block prefixes; native Terraform validation remains necessary.
The new-rule admission gate requires WARNING first. Blocking ERROR promotion follows in a separate change after that version is published.
Finite sampled calibration does not prove absence of field false negatives or safe removal of any guarded constraint.
